feature_contract.goal: Avoid whole-buffer CPU memory copies after a single safe partial dynamic vertex or index buffer update, while preserving identical source data and conservative original D3D9 fallback for all unsafe generations.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only CPU VB/IB shadow generation-aware incremental snapshots; no stereo geometry, compositor, HUD, menu, SkyGlow, FFB, DX11 or frozen DXVK edits.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R30CopyVertexShadow/R30CopyIndexShadow currently re-copy full requested shadow byte ranges on every changed generation even when a game streaming Lock/Unlock writes only a small subrange. Safe one-revision overlap copy replaces O(full draw span) CPU memcpy with O(changed overlap) while all other writes retain full-copy fallback. Quest3 performance has not been measured.
trace_stages: OutRun game dynamic VB and IB Lock/Unlock producers write tracked byte intervals to CPU shadows.
R30 scratch snapshot is normally copied as an entire range on generation change, even for one non-DISCARD write.
Each eye consumes the same updated source/IB bytes via R30 geometry classifier and stereo draw; unsafe revisions use existing conservative full-copy/fallback.
subcomponents: Track exactly one successful non-DISCARD write generation and its byte interval under the per-buffer mutex.
Refresh only the intersection with a matching previously complete snapshot; retain full-copy on multiple writes, DISCARD, failed Unlock, changed ranges and incomplete coverage.
Integrate destructive-mutant and randomized differential tests into the exact-SHA Windows game/host/package CI gate.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Single covered safe VB/IB partial writes refresh only dirty overlapping bytes; unchanged/disjoint snapshot data remains correct for both eyes.
DISCARD, multiple generations, failed Unlock, invalid ranges and different buffers never use stale partial bytes; full validation or original fallback remains active.
R30 incremental safety mutation/reference parity and exact-SHA DX9Ex Win32 host/game/package, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact gates succeed.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Both R30CopyVertexShadow and R30CopyIndexShadow call out.resize(size); std::memcpy(..., size) on any revision mismatch despite common small dynamic partial Lock/Unlock writes.
diagnosis.root_cause: Shadow cache tracks whole-entry revision but does not retain a safe latest write interval, so a single partial update always forces an unnecessary full requested-range CPU copy.
source_trace: D3D9 game Lock/Unlock writes observed byte intervals, DISCARD invalidates CPU coverage.
R30 registered buffer mutex guards generation and source bytes, scratch cache stores a prior full copy.
R30 stereo transform and indexed draw take that snapshot for both eyes, or delegate to original rendering on missing coverage.
alternatives_rejected: Blind partial refresh after any revision can replay stale bytes across intervening writes or DISCARD.
Updating a shared mutable cache without its mutex risks a torn snapshot between eyes.
Using only the most recent write after two or more generations misses earlier edited spans.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Track final successful non-DISCARD write interval and gate overlap refresh on exactly one generation difference and complete coverage.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Source structural destructive mutations and 3500 randomized interval/revision/discard/failure parity tests under exact-SHA CI.

performance_evidence: Source-only reduction in bytes copied for one partial VB/IB write; no runtime FPS or frame-time improvement measured. Automated copy-byte model parity succeeded; no FPS benefit claimed without HMD.

initial_failure.cause: Legacy full-copy cache verifier counted new incremental helper parameter as a third VB/IB reader and targeted shared mutation tokens outside the readers.

repair.description: Preserve old VB/IB full-copy semantics through reader-scoped negative mutations, and explicitly verify incremental-before-full-copy ordering.

validation_evidence.runtime: Quest3/VDXR HMD, optical appearance, FPS and p95/p99 not run. RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED
